subject: ISL
label: Grade 02
task: Meet the outcome of every unit in Grade 02 Islamic studies, and keep one piece of evidence for each.
condition: A 36-week school year, 6 units, a teacher or guide, a learning book or device, and local examples in the local language first with English support.
standard: Each unit: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school. Course pass: no unit at 'Not yet' after one retry, and a pass in SA1 and SA2.

modules.title: The Holy Qur'an: recitation and memorisation
modules.outcome: recite and understand the selected passages for this grade
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'The Holy Qur'an: recitation and memorisation', taught in a way that is short, playful, with objects, pictures and talk. The target is clear: recite and understand the selected passages for this grade. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen and talk: hear a short story, text or example linked to 'The Holy Qur'an: recitation and memorisation' and say what it means in your own words.
Connect: name one place in your own day where it applies.
Use it: recite and understand the selected passages for this grade. Practise with care and respect, in class and at home.
Reflect: what went well, what was hard, and one thing you will do next time.
modules.example: Model run for 'The Holy Qur'an: recitation and memorisation'. A short text or story is read aloud. Learners say the main lesson in one sentence. In pairs they find one moment in school or home where this lesson would help. Each learner plans one small action for the week and tells it to a partner. At the end of the week they report back. What a good answer looks like: the lesson is in the learner's own words, the example is real and local, and the action is small enough to do. Content follows the approved local syllabus and is checked by a qualified teacher.
modules.activity: About 20 to 30 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: one page in your learning book.
modules.standard: Recite and understand the selected passages for this grade: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school.

Which action verb starts the outcome of Unit 1 (The Holy Qur'an: recitation and memorisation), and at which Bloom level is it?
'recite', at the Remember level.
When do the formative checks FA1 to FA4 and the summative checks SA1 and SA2 happen?
FA1 to FA4 around weeks 6, 12, 24 and 30; SA1 in week 18; SA2 in week 36.
In which weeks does Unit 6 (Islamic civilisation and contribution) run?
Weeks 31 to 36.
What evidence do you keep for each unit, and why?
One page in your learning book. It shows what you can really do and lets a teacher check it against the standard.
ladder: L1: kindness, honesty and sharing in daily life.
L2: responsibility, courage and care for others and nature.
L3: fairness, respect for difference and service.
L5: leadership, wellbeing and ethical reasoning.
L6 (degree): applied ethics, culture and community work.
L7 (postgraduate): scholarship, counselling or teaching at depth.
